Example Manufacturing Ltd (fictional) - strategy:
Pillars: (1) High-quality, flexible production: precision machining, standards-compliant welding, customized solutions and fast deliveries. (2) Strong customer relationships: long-term construction and energy customers, trust, fast problem solving and Nordic expansion. (3) Development and investment: digitalization and automation since 2018, data-driven production within five years and carbon neutrality by 2035.
